Infra LATAM 2027
(Formerly known as IJ LATAM)
Don't Miss Out - Super Early Bird Rate Ends Friday

For over 20 years, Infra LATAM has been the region’s leading energy and infrastructure finance conference, connecting LPs, GPs, lenders, developers, project sponsors, and advisors from across Latin America.

Over the course of three days, we'll explore the projects, capital flows, and investment trends shaping the LATAM infrastructure market today, from project finance and private credit to digital infrastructure, energy transition, BESS, and M&A.

Join us and over 750 delegates from the region’s most active players for unrivalled networking - ideal for fundraising, deal origination and sourcing.

View the agenda and 2027 topics here >>

Book by Friday, November 6 to save $1,000!
Prices will increas after this date.

Contact our team to discuss how we can tailor a sponsorship package to meet your strategic objectives. Contact: Bradley Cole, Global Head of Business Development
